name: you want to see me?_THESEUS
source:
It's a rainy evening and such awhile since the last time you had an afterwork treat. You take a seat in a tent food stall nearby.  What comes after is one thing that startle you - even just for a bit. 

That one person you avoided for years - he's here, seemingly so keen upon meeting your eyes.  His eyes still the same as you could remember, how you knew much about those pair - yet refuse to indulge.  The rain outside is strong, and he's approaching.

— what could possibly happen if you stop avoiding him?

[From [url=https://enkadenka.itch.io/ywtsm-theseus]Itch.io[/url]]
